columns.name: patient
columns.description: The unique identifier of the patient.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The name of the patient, formed by concatenating the first name and last name with a space in between.

columns.name: birthdate
columns.description: The birth date of the patient

columns.name: highest_Systolic_Blood_Pressure_observed
columns.description: The highest systolic blood pressure observed for the patient.

columns.name: number_of_immunizations
columns.description: The number of immunizations the patient has received, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_encounters_between_2010_and_2017
columns.description: The number of encounters the patient has with medical professionals between 2010 and 2017, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_received_the_IPV_and_is_english
columns.description: Set to 1 if the patient has received the IPV and his/her ethnicity is English, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: time_recieve_most_recent_vaccine
columns.description: The time when the patient received her/his most recent influenza seasonal vaccine
